rules.name: Warlord
rules.description:
• If your Warlord dies all friendly Units within 8” must make a Panic Test (unless they are Immune to Panic).
• Every friendly Unit 8” from the Warlord may use his LD for Psychology Tests.

rules.name: Breath of Life
rules.description:
Range: B2B
Level: 5
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: The most complete Alchemists of all the Orders are said to have created a potion able to imbue life to the recently departed. Some have accused it of having the necromantic powers of the Dark One, others disregard it as a lie, but the potion is still used as a last resort. 
Effect: If you are in possession of a Breath of Life Potion and a friendly model dies, do not remove the model, instead place the model on its side. The model is considered dead and may not make its Activation (the model cannot be targeted by the enemy). The next time the model is “Activated”, remove it from the table as a casualty, unless the Spellcaster has successfully reached the dead model and revived it with The Breath of Life Potion. If the Breath of Life Potion is successful, stand the “dead” model back up with 1 Wound remaining. The revived model can Activate and act normally this turn.

rules.name: Fire Bomb
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 5
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3 
Description: A concoction of oil, sulphur and more mystical substances, creates an extremely incendiary mix, whose fire will not go out with mere water.
Effect: Pick a target model up to 20” from the Spellcaster and in LOS. Use Target Priority as if you were using a shooting weapon. If successfully cast place the centre of a Small Explosion Template on the target. Every model under the template receives a Firebased Attack with Dam 10. A Fumble in this situation means that you place the centre of a Small Explosion Template on the Spellcaster who attempted to use a Fire Bomb.

rules.name: Mending Potion
rules.description:
Range: Self or B2B
Level: 3
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: The Alchemist Orders have found a rare plant extract that, if applied directly on a wound, will stop any bleeding and allow the injured man to stay in the fight.
Effect: After drinking this potion the target heals 1 Wound. The target must be alive to use the potion. This cannot be used to increase Wounds above their starting value.

rules.name: Poison Gas
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 5
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: After a housewife in Hazad dropped dead upon inhaling a spice extracted from the mines, and commonly used for cooking, the Alchemists began thinking...
Effect: Choose a target model up to 20” from the Spellcaster and within LOS. Use Target Priority as if you were shooting. If successfully cast place the centre of a Small Explosion Template on the target. Every model under the template needs to take a Dex test. If the Dex test is failed, all attacks they receive until end of the turn are treated as Poison Attacks. A Fumble in this situation means that you place the centre of a Small Explosion Template on the Spellcaster who attempted to use Poison Gas.

rules.name: Potion of Fire
rules.description:
Range: Self or B2B
Level: 3
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: The recipient of the potion feels a strange heat taking over their body, able to fend off the fiercest of colds.
Effect: After drinking this potion the target gains the Skill: Immune to Frost Based Attacks, until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Regeneration Potion
rules.description:
Range: Self or B2B
Level: 3
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: A rare substance extracted from a snail that lives exclusively in the Fallen Land, East of the Empire, allows the recipient to mend all but the most grievous wounds.
Effect: After drinking this potion the target gains the Skill: Regeneration (5) , until the end of the game. The effects of this potion are cumulative. Further uses of this grant the Skill: Regeneration (+1) (to a maximum of 8).

rules.name: Smoke Bomb
rules.description:
Range: 20” and LOS
Level: 5
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: After years of experimentation, the Alchemists of the Burning Star found that mixing two substances creates a reaction that produces a thick, plume of smoke.
Effect: Choose a target point on the battlefield up to 20” from the Spellcaster and within LOS. If successfully cast place the centre of a Small Explosion Template on a target. A Fumble in this situation means that you place the centre of a Small Explosion Template on the Spellcaster who attempted to use a Smoke Bomb. Smoke blocks LOS just as a Terrain Feature: Forests would do. Every model under the template has to take a Dex test or become Dazed. At the beginning of the End Phase, when you are checking Spell Effects, roll a D20 for Deviation and move the Smoke Template. Every model that is touched by the Smoke Template while it is moving or when it has finished its move, must take a Dex test. You cannot cast another Smoke Bomb until the first one has evaporated (leaves the game board).

rules.name: Toughness Potion
rules.description:
Range: Self or B2B
Level: 2
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: A simple potion provided to the Ogre royalty to sooth severe headaches. It can stop the daze caused by a blunt blow to a helmet.
Effect: After drinking this potion the target gains the Skill: Immune to Dazed until the end of the turn. You can use this potion even if you are already Dazed.

rules.name: Potion of Ice
rules.description:
Range: Self or B2B
Level: 3
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 1
Description: Some claim that the Potion of Ice has minuscule quantities of Lotus extract, cultivated in the Lotus Peaks. How this immeasurably valuable commodity would come into the possession of the Blackblood Alchemists remains unknown.
Effect: After drinking this potion the target gains the Skill: Immune to Firebased attacks, until the end of the turn.
